source.name: Houston Astros press release: Oxy Named the Official Jersey Partner of the Houston Astros
source.note: Club announcement, read via the Wayback Machine capture of 2026-04-12 because the live mlb.com page blocks scripts. Patch still on the 2026 jersey: Blinkfire's 2026 MLB jersey-patch list (2026-04-20, https://analyticsblog.blinkfire.com/blog/2026/04/20/mlb-2026-jersey-patches-brands-buying-into-baseball/).
source.quote: Oxy will become the team’s official jersey partner for the next seven seasons. The Oxy logo will be featured on the Astros jersey sleeve
